meta.name: frame-flowchart-sticky
meta.description: SVG 曲线连接 + 便利贴节点 + 光标交互, 像白板 brainstorm

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在白板上绘制曲线连接和便利贴节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在白板风格中快速绘制连接图和便签
copy.tagline_en: Draw curved connections and sticky notes on a whiteboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly draw connection diagrams and sticky notes in a whiteboard style

howto.what: Claude 会产出一个 1920×1080 的单文件 HTML:米黄或冷灰白板纸上贴 240×180 便利贴节点(黄、桃、薄荷、天四色随机、轻微旋转、胶带装饰),节点含 emoji 或 inline 图标、手写体标题和一行描述,节点间用 SVG 贝塞尔曲线实线或虚线连黑色小箭头,另可选 hover 抬起和模拟协作光标。
howto.when: 当你要把流程、系统或工作流画成白板便利贴样式时使用,原文点名的场景有 onboarding 视频、运营流程说明、系统架构讲解;节点文字直接取自你的输入。

say.text: 把我们的用户 onboarding 流程画成白板便利贴图
改成 8 个节点,加两条虚线分支
换成冷灰白板底,节点用手写体
say.note: 字体不能用 Inter 或衬线

howto.what_en: Claude outputs one 1920×1080 HTML file: 240×180px sticky notes in four random colors with handwriting fonts and tape, on a cream or cool grey board with faint hex grid, joined by SVG Bezier paths with small black arrowheads, optionally with hover lift and a fake collab cursor.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a process, system or workflow drawn as a whiteboard with sticky notes; the source names onboarding videos, ops flows and architecture explainers, and node text comes from your input.

say_en.text: Draw our user onboarding flow as a whiteboard sticky-note chart
Reroute it to 8 nodes and add two dashed branches
Switch to a cool grey board and handwriting fonts
say_en.note: Inter and serif fonts are not allowed
